name: Ca thoi loi
summary: Cá thòi lòi is the mudskipper of the cape flats, a fish that swims, runs across the mud, and climbs. It is not bony and not strongly fishy, and comes grilled, in a hotpot, braised with pepper, or dried.
origin: The mangrove flats of the cape. VOV calls it a newer dish that visitors now ask for.
taste: Not bony and not strongly fishy.
howToEat: Order it grilled, in a hotpot, kho tiêu (braised with black pepper), or dried.
where: The mangrove flats of the cape.
seoTitle: Ca thoi loi — Ca Mau mudskipper
seoDescription: Cá thòi lòi is the mudskipper of the Cà Mau flats, not bony and not strongly fishy. Order it grilled, in a hotpot, kho tiêu, or dried.
